Grow Faster. We’re always looking for the ones truly passionate about their work. If you are amongst them, you can rest assured there is a place for you in eMAG. We grew very fast and we are determined to keep doing so. What brought us here is our desire for continuous evolution and practical results. At eMAG, a set of strong principles guide our daily work: we understand the client, we think like a successful entrepreneur, we make decisions supported by data, we assess the impact of our projects, we act responsibly, we support each other and we grow with the business. They define us and help us become the favorite shopping destination for our clients. Almost 6000 people are working now in eMAG. We strongly believe in people development and therefore every year we invest more and more energy and resources to remain an organization that is constantly learning. We want to make sure that you’ll have the most talented colleagues, as well as the proper environment to grow and achieve great results, to become what you desire on a personal and professional level.

We strongly believe in peoples development and therefore every year we invest more and more energy and resources to remain an organization that is constantly learning. We want to ensure that youll have the most talented colleagues and the proper environment to grow and achieve great results, to become what you desire on a personal and professional level. Join us, grow faster!  AI Platform Engineer (InsightOps, DevEx & Cloud Enablement Team)  InsightOps is the team that measures and governs how 800+ engineers at eMAG build software. We own the FinOps and engineering-insights layer in Backstage: cloud and AI costs across AWS, GCP, Tencent and the LLM providers, developer productivity data (Jira, GitLab, GetDX, worklogs), Jira administration and automation, and the seat and license governance for AI tools (Cursor, Claude Code and the rest of the AI coding stack). In short, we make sure managers have clear, reliable data on what their teams use and what it costs.  Were looking for an AI Platform Engineer to own the AI insights and governance layer: from AI cost attribution and budget controls, to adoption and productivity metrics, seat and API key lifecycle automation, and AI agents that turn our engineering data into answers. Youll work at the intersection of FinOps, developer analytics and platform engineering. What youll have to do: Owning AI cost governance: attributing OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini and AI-tool spend to teams and products through provider admin APIs, key mapping and the AI Costs plugin in Backstage;  Building the AI usage data pipeline (provider billing exports, gateway telemetry, Cursor and Claude admin APIs) into Backstage, Tableau and Elasticsearch, reconciled monthly against invoices;  Automating the seat and API key lifecycle for AI tools: provisioning, migrations, inactive-seat reclaim and budget alerts, with audit trails for compliance;  Measuring AI adoption and impact across the SDLC (GetDX, Jira, GitLab, worklogs) and surfacing it as role-aware views for managers and executives;  Building AI-powered insights over our engineering data: agents and MCP servers on Jira, GitLab, Backstage and cost data, ticket smart routing, spend anomaly and infrastructure drift detection;  Productionizing agentic workflows for reporting, Jira automation and SDLC audit evidence, with evaluation, guardrails and cost controls;  Partnering with the AI tooling and security teams on AI policy enforcement and data classification;  Measuring and documenting what you build: cost saved, adoption rate, data freshness and correctness.   What makes you a good fit: 3+ years of backend, data or platform engineering experience (Python or TypeScript/Node.js), comfortable with SQL and data pipelines;  Hands-on experience with LLM APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini), including usage and billing endpoints -- building integrations, not just prompting;  Agentic workflow design (tool-use, multi-step reasoning, orchestration) and MCP (Model Context Protocol) server development;  Familiarity with Docker/Kubernetes and CI/CD (GitLab CI preferred);  Understanding of FinOps: cost allocation, showback and chargeback, budgets, anomaly detection; AWS, GCP or Tencent cost tooling is a plus;  Experience with LLM observability and cost instrumentation (Langfuse or similar) and reporting tools (Tableau, Kibana or similar);  Nice to have: Backstage plugin development (React/TypeScript), Jira REST API and automation, developer-productivity analytics;  You think in systems and data, not features, and care whether a number is right before it reaches a dashboard;  You measure your own impact -- cost saved, adoption rate, data quality -- and document what you build so others can extend it.  What weve prepared for you: Medical subscription: Medicover or Regina Maria.  A flexible budget that you can invest in yourself as you wish: meal tickets, holiday tickets, cultural vouchers, private pension, foreign language classes, eMAG, Fashion Days, Therme & Genius, membership to different gyms or even professional development classes.   Different discounts from our partners: banking, mobile, dental medicine or wellness.   Access to the Bookster library and free credits on the Hilio psycho-emotional health platform.  An accelerated learning environment, with access to over 100.000 curated online resources and platforms, learning academies and development programs.  New headquarters, where sleek design, natural light, and versatile spaces create an energizing and comfortable environment for hybrid work.  #LI-hybrid #midsenior Curious to find out more about the next step in your career? Apply now and if your experience is relevant for the role you wish, we will give you a call for more details! Also, here you can find our confidentiality policy if you want to consult it.
